segments.name: Exploration and production
segments.description: Natural gas-weighted exploration and production targeting the Utica/Marcellus formations in eastern Ohio and SCOOP formations in central Oklahoma.
segments.evidence: Gulfport is an independent natural gas-weighted exploration and production company with assets primarily located in the Appalachia and Anadarko basins.

revenueModel.text: Purchasers pay Gulfport for oil and natural gas produced and sold from its wells.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells oil and natural gas to various purchasers and participates in drilling, completion and operation of oil and natural gas wells with joint interest owners on properties the Company operates.
